summary.text: Jesse St. Gelais is the Republican candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives, 8th Bristol District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the Republican primary on September 1, 2026.

paragraphs.text: St. Gelais ran for the same seat in 2024 as an unenrolled candidate, finishing third in the open-seat general election with 19.1 percent of the vote (4,232 votes); Democrat Steven Ouellette won the race.
